prompts.library_complete_prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Produce one finished 1672×941 high-definition pixel-art game environment by rendering the supplied geometry guide. Image 1 is the exact composition and ground-plan guide, not visual style. Image 2 is the approved material, fixed camera and pixel-texture reference. Image 3 is the adjoining original monastery reference. This is GC02, a single enclosed scripture library and teaching courtyard on the mountain terrace behind and slightly east of the main hall.
Preserve image 1 coordinates precisely: one 6-metre library foundation spans x540..1020 and front foot y555, its rear ground y455. The full closed building has a blue-grey tiled roof around x485..1080,y180..400, substantial timber-and-plaster walls from the eaves to y555, and a front double wooden door centred x780, lower threshold y555 with net opening about 140 pixels high. Short front stone steps finish at the walkable foot (780,575). The entire building is about 375 pixels high. Show a complete enclosed room with roof depth, side walls and proper foundation, suited to the same adult 111-pixel character scale as the reference; no humans are drawn.
A clearly walkable earth-and-worn-stone path comes up from the bottom image edge at EXACTLY (189,941), continues through (189,821),(190,781),(330,760),(520,730), then runs horizontally along y730 through x800,x1100 to x1460. A straight clear front approach joins the door foot (780,575) to (780,730). Path width approximately 60 pixels. The house forecourt and expansion ground across x430..1450,y400..695 must be mostly level short-grass and firm stone-dust earth, with the existing 6m house in its left-middle; keep x1020..1450 clear for the future 10m enlargement. The dashed guide reserve from (540,455) to (1340,622) must be natural cleared land around the current house. The roads and door foot are uninterrupted walkable surfaces. Use low flush stones at their borders.
Match reference 2's crisp richly detailed pixel clusters, blue-grey roof tiles, warm wood, grey stone, clear daylight and mountain pines; reduce the yellow cast slightly toward reference 3's calm blue-green palette. A restrained library identity: lattice windows, discreet sealed scroll cabinets and stacked book cases beside the front wall, subtle scholarly ornament. Place these off the door approach. No cooking stove, medicine racks or copied clinic/kitchen props. Behind and at outer margins: pine woodland, layered rocky mountains and mist; keep the broad usable terrace in the foreground. This is a playable environment, not a diagram. Remove all guide labels, red dots, dashed lines and flat guide shapes; render naturally. No text, lettering, signs, interface, people, statues of people or baked character sprites. Keep the camera direction and scale fixed, not an aerial map.
